slides.headline: Royal Enfield's Free Warranty: Up to 10 Years in the UK, 3 in India

slides.stat_label: Royal Enfield's Free UK Warranty From 20 Nov
bullets: Up to 10 years or 70,000 miles, free
Each yearly RE UK dealer service adds a year
UK-registered bikes only; wear parts aren't covered
slides.credit_line: Sources: Royal Enfield UK, Visordown, Rushlane

slides.stat_label: Which Royal Enfields the UK Scheme Covers
bullets: Bikes under warranty, plus new ones from 20 Nov
slides.credit_line: Sources: Royal Enfield UK, Visordown, The Highland Times

slides.stat_label: Royal Enfield Classic 350's Standard Warranty in India
bullets: 3 years or 30,000 km, whichever comes first
UK's free cap, 1,12,654 km, is about 3.8x that
Royal Enfield hasn't announced it for India
